exact_prompt:
Edit this exact full-canvas game diffuse texture into a modest HD hand-painted version. The attached image is the entire original 64x128 stored RGB canvas enlarged exactly by nearest-neighbor to 256x512. This is a strict texture UV map reference. Return the entire 1:2 canvas with exactly the same positions, dimensions, scale, black gaps, material fields, internal soft patches and contours. No crop, padding, recentering, zoom, frame or whitespace.

Keep the very dark charcoal gray slightly warm painted metal, matte muted appearance and all original faint tonal patches. Preserve the upper-left dim ribbed field, the short top-right rectangular field with EXACTLY TWO existing blurry dark paintmarks, the central rounded dark polygon, the broad gray left rectangle, the dim lower-left short strip with its EXACTLY ONE faint circular paintmark, the original separate dark middle-right field, and the full bottom curved gray fields. Preserve each weak round lightpatch and black notch in its exact source shape. These blurry marks are painted texture content, not an invitation to add screws, rivets or hardware holes.

The upper-left faint row-profile maxima occur at native source y=1,5,8,11,13,16,19,22,25,28,32,34,37 within x=4..23, original full source 64x128. Preserve all these thirteen weak tonal maxima and their irregular spacing and phase; do not regularize them into a different number of stronger grooves. Keep their original scale and softness. Gently resolve only the existing fine irregular painted material. No extra rib, raised stitching, new edge, crack, grain, scratch, speck, bolt, bright plate, white glint, engraving, new shadowgeometry, logo, text or decorative curl. Preserve weak source highlights and relative brightness throughout. Output the opaque full UV canvas; source alpha will be restored separately.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST4x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.

pattern_constraints.sourceparts: Full dark gray metal pincer atlas. Exactly two source dark blurry marks in top-right short rectangle, exactly one existing faint circular paintmark in middle-left lower strip. Curved lower fields, left broad rectangle, central dark polygon, weak round lightpatches stay original count/positions. Do not interpret blurry paintspots as new hardware holes/rivets.
pattern_constraints.source_repeat_profile: Top-left dark ribs: actual source meanRGB row-profile maxima over native x[4,24), y[0,40) = [1,5,8,11,13,16,19,22,25,28,32,34,37]. This is measured paint-profile count13, not a claim of exact idealized period. Do not regularize irregular spacing or strengthen these weak ridges.
pattern_constraints.marks: No extra screws/holes/edges, dim mottled metalpaint preserved rather than physical photoreal specular metal.

reference_argument_serialization: Actual built-in references absolute current repo paths; these portable identities reproduce the same exact byte SHA256 inputs.
